# Byterygon UI registry

> Base UI components styled with Byterygon design-token roles, as a static shadcn registry. No network: install from this folder or from a static server you host.

Install (components.json: "registries": { "@byterygon": "<this folder or URL>/{name}.json" }, "tailwind": { "baseColor": "" }):

    shadcn add <this folder>/theme-default.json @byterygon/button

## Themes

- [theme-default](theme-default.json): The Byterygon default theme: a blue-teal brand on a neutral tinted with the same hue, light by default, comfortable density, WCAG 2.2 AA.
- [theme-high-contrast](theme-high-contrast.json): High contrast: WCAG 2.2 AAA (7:1 text, 4.5:1 for controls and focus), pure grey neutral, a deep blue accent and a thick focus ring. Comfortable density.
- [theme-midnight](theme-midnight.json): Midnight: dark first, on a deep blue neutral with a periwinkle accent. The light scheme is a cool blue-tinted counterpart. Comfortable density.
- [theme-paper](theme-paper.json): Paper: a warm light theme for reading. Cream backgrounds, a rust accent, larger text with relaxed line height, rounder corners, comfortable density.
- [theme-slate](theme-slate.json): Slate: near-greyscale and minimal. A muted slate-blue accent on a barely tinted neutral, square-ish corners, light by default, comfortable density.
- [theme-terminal](theme-terminal.json): Terminal: dark first, a green accent on a green-black neutral, monospace for all interface text, 13 px text, square corners, compact density.

## Components

### AlertDialog

[alert-dialog.json](alert-dialog.json): A decision the user must make before going on, on Base UI's AlertDialog: Dialog's scrim and popup with role="alertdialog", no close button and no dismissal by an outside click, a Cancel and an Action in the footer.

Usage: Use AlertDialog to confirm an action that destroys data or cannot be undone (delete a connection, run a destructive statement) or to approve something with consequences (grant access). Compose it as AlertDialog > AlertDialogTrigger (render a Button; or open it through open) + AlertDialogContent > AlertDialogHeader (AlertDialogTitle: the question or consequence; AlertDialogDescription), an optional AlertDialogBody (the statement, the target), AlertDialogFooter (AlertDialogCancel, then the action). An action that finishes at once can be an AlertDialogCancel with variant="danger" (it closes); an action that waits for the core is an AlertDialogAction with loading, and the caller closes the dialog through open when it succeeds. Name the action after what it does ("Delete", "Approve and save"), not "OK". For a task that may be dismissed freely use Dialog.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/alert-dialog
- Parts: AlertDialogTrigger (data-slot alert-dialog-trigger): Opens the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render.; AlertDialogContent (data-slot alert-dialog-content): The portal with the scrim, the viewport and the popup; no close button.; AlertDialogBackdrop (data-slot alert-dialog-backdrop): The scrim; AlertDialogContent renders it.; AlertDialogViewport (data-slot alert-dialog-viewport): The centring layer; AlertDialogContent renders it.; AlertDialogHeader (data-slot alert-dialog-header): The title and description, stacked.; AlertDialogTitle (data-slot alert-dialog-title): An <h2> in type.heading-4 that names the dialog.; AlertDialogDescription (data-slot alert-dialog-description): A <p> in color.fg.muted that describes the dialog.; AlertDialogBody (data-slot alert-dialog-body): What the decision is about; scrolls when long.; AlertDialogFooter (data-slot alert-dialog-footer): Cancel, then the action, at the end of the row.; AlertDialogCancel (data-slot alert-dialog-cancel): A Button (ghost by default) that closes the dialog.; AlertDialogAction (data-slot alert-dialog-action): A Button (primary by default) that runs the action and does not close the dialog by itself.
- size: sm, md, lg, xl
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", default "md"); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger"); loading (boolean, default false); initialFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, elevation.modal.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.slow, motion.easing.emphasized, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.icon.sm, size.panel.lg, size.panel.md, size.panel.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.stack.md, space.stack.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight, text.heading-4.leading, text.heading-4.size, text.heading-4.tracking, text.heading-4.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The popup is role="alertdialog", named by AlertDialogTitle and described by AlertDialogDescription; while it is open the rest of the page is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Opening moves focus to the first focusable element (Cancel in the usual footer order, so Enter does not confirm by accident); Tab stays inside; closing returns focus to the trigger. Escape closes it (as Cancel); a press outside does not. The action names what it does; a destructive one uses the danger variant and its text, so the meaning does not rest on colour. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.

### Button

[button.json](button.json): An action button: primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants in three density-aware sizes, with disabled and loading states.

Usage: Use one primary Button per view for the main action, secondary next to it, ghost in toolbars and dense rows, danger for destructive actions. Give it a visible text label; for an icon alone use IconButton. Set loading while the action runs instead of disabling it, and type="submit" inside a form.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/button
- variant: primary, secondary, ghost, danger
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", default "primary"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); loading (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); type ("button" | "submit" | "reset", default "button"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.fg.default, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it. An icon-only button needs aria-label. Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable (aria-disabled) so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy. The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only (focus-visible) and meets 3:1 against every surface (token pair color.ring). Text and background pairs of every variant are contrast-checked by the token build in light and dark.

### Calendar

[calendar.json](calendar.json): A month grid to pick one day, several days or a range, on react-day-picker with date-fns, styled with token roles: control-sized day buttons, the accent solid for the chosen day and the accent subtle band for a range.

Usage: Use Calendar on its own where the month should stay visible (a history window, a schedule), or let DatePicker open it in a popup next to a text field. Set mode to "single", "multiple" or "range" and pass selected and onSelect as react-day-picker's (Date, Date[] or { from, to }). Limit the choice with disabled matchers ({ before }, { after }, a weekday list), show two months for ranges with numberOfMonths={2}, and pass a date-fns locale for the language and the first day of the week (weekStartsOn overrides it). Give it an aria-label that says what the date is for. To type a date, or to keep the form compact, use DatePicker; for a time of day, TimePicker.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Parts: CalendarDayButton (data-slot calendar-day-button): A day: a size.control.md square button in a gridcell; data-selected, data-today, data-outside, data-disabled and data-range-start, -middle, -end show its state. Calendar renders it; pass it as components.DayButton when wrapping it.
- Props: mode ("single" | "multiple" | "range"); selected (Date | Date[] | DateRange); onSelect ((selected, triggerDate, modifiers, event) => void); required (boolean, default false); disabled (Matcher | Matcher[]); defaultMonth (Date); startMonth (Date); numberOfMonths (number, default 1); showOutsideDays (boolean, default true); showWeekNumber (boolean, default false); locale (Locale (date-fns)); weekStartsOn (0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6); footer (ReactNode); aria-label (string); className (string)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), hover (hover), selected (data-selected), range-middle (data-range-middle), range-start (data-range-start), today (data-today), outside (data-outside), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xl, space.stack.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: Each month is a role="grid" named by its month; the days are buttons in gridcells whose labels give the full date and say when it is today or selected (aria-selected on the cell). One day is in the tab order (the chosen day, else today, else the first day); the arrow keys move a day or a week, Home and End to the week's start and end, PageUp and PageDown a month (with Shift a year), and Enter or Space chooses. The caption is a polite live region, so moving to another month announces it; the navigation buttons are named "Go to the Previous Month" and "Go to the Next Month" (the labels prop renames them) and are aria-disabled at the limits. Disabled days are skipped as choices and struck through as well as dimmed; today carries a border and the strong weight besides its colour. Give the calendar an aria-label that says what the date is for; pass a date-fns locale to have the labels in the user's language.

### Checkbox

[checkbox.json](checkbox.json): A checkbox on Base UI's Checkbox, ticked, unticked or mixed, in three sizes, with CheckboxGroup for several checkboxes sharing one value and a parent "select all".

Usage: Use Checkbox for a yes/no choice that is applied when the form is submitted ("Include column headers"), and CheckboxGroup for picking any number of options from a short list. Wrap each checkbox and its text in a FieldLabel inside a Field; in a group, put a FieldLegend first and each option in a FieldItem. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur (or the group's value and onValueChange) to the field. For a setting that takes effect at once use Switch; for one choice out of several, RadioGroup; for a long list, a MultiSelect.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/checkbox
- Parts: CheckboxGroup (data-slot checkbox-group): Checkboxes sharing one string[] value, a column with gap space.stack.sm; a fieldset named by its FieldLegend.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: checked (boolean); defaultChecked (boolean, default false); onCheckedChange ((checked: boolean, details) => void); indeterminate (boolean, default false); value (string); parent (boolean, default false); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLSpanElement>)
- States: hover (hover), checked (data-checked), indeterminate (data-indeterminate), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.xs, ring.offset, ring.width, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, space.stack.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a <span role="checkbox"> with aria-checked (true, false or mixed) and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it and Space toggles it. Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text then toggles it too and enlarges the target beyond the 14 to 20 px box (WCAG 2.2 target size). A group is a fieldset named by its FieldLegend; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only. Ticked and mixed are shown by a check or a dash as well as the accent fill; the unticked border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Combobox

[combobox.json](combobox.json): One choice from a long list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox: an input in an Input-like frame with clear and open buttons, and a popup of filtered items, groups, a no-results line and a status line, in three sizes.

Usage: Use Combobox when the user picks one value from a list too long to scan (tables, roles, time zones) or knows what to type. Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items (strings, { value, label } objects, groups of { value, items }, or a Combobox.createItems collection to store ids) and a function child that renders each item as a ComboboxItem; Base UI filters by label as the user types and the first match is highlighted, so Enter takes it. Show loading or an error of an async search with status, and say what was searched for with emptyMessage. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For a short fixed list use Select; for several values, MultiSelect; for free text with suggestions, an Input.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/combobox
- Parts: ComboboxItem (data-slot combobox-item): One item, role="option": its content, and a check mark while chosen; color.interactive.hover while highlighted.; ComboboxGroup (data-slot combobox-group): A group of items, role="group", named by its ComboboxGroupLabel; render its items in a ComboboxCollection.; ComboboxGroupLabel (data-slot combobox-group-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ComboboxSeparator (data-slot combobox-separator): A 1 px line in color.border.default between items or groups.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: items (Item[] | { value, items: Item[] }[] | ComboboxItemCollection); value (Value | null); defaultValue (Value | null); onValueChange ((value: Value | null, details) => void); inputValue (string); filter ((item, query) => boolean | null); placeholder (string); emptyMessage (ReactNode, default "\"No results.\""); status (ReactNode); autoHighlight (boolean, default true); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); clearLabel (string, default "\"Clear\""); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[input:focus-visible]), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), hover (hover), highlighted (data-highlighted), no value (not-data-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.focus, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected, in role="group"s named by their labels. Typing filters and opens the list; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight while focus stays in the input (aria-activedescendant), Enter chooses, Escape closes and then clears, and Tab leaves. The chevron button is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology, as the input already opens the list; the clear button is reachable by pointer and is named by clearLabel. The status line is aria-live="polite", so loading and errors of an async search are announced without moving focus; the no-results line is announced the same way. The chosen item shows a check mark, so the state does not rest on colour; the frame border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

### CommandPalette

[command-palette.json](command-palette.json): The searchable list of every action, on Base UI's Dialog and an inline Autocomplete: a search field over grouped commands with icons and shortcuts, filtered in the page by label and keywords, opened by a hotkey; no network.

Usage: Use CommandPalette as the one place where every action of the app can be found and run from the keyboard, with its shortcut shown: DBee's Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P. Pass groups of commands ({ id, label, shortcut, keywords, icon, disabled, onSelect }), control open with open and onOpenChange (and a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" for pointer users), and give hotkeys ("Mod+K": Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere) to toggle it anywhere. The palette closes before onSelect runs, so a command may open a dialog. Keep the list in sync with the app's shortcuts; for a few actions behind a button use DropdownMenu; for picking a value in a form, Combobox.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/autocomplete
- Parts: CommandPaletteItem (data-slot command-palette-item): One command's row, role="option": icon, label and shortcut (<kbd>), DropdownMenu's item look; CommandPalette renders one per command.
- Props: groups ({ label: string; items: Command[] }[]); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean) => void); hotkeys (string[]); placeholder (string, default "Type a command"); emptyText (ReactNode, default "No matching commands"); title (string, default "Command palette"); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.modal.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.slow, motion.easing.emphasized, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, radius.lg, radius.sm, size.control.lg, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.panel.lg, size.panel.sm, space.inline.lg, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.md, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The palette is a modal role="dialog" named by a visually hidden title; focus goes to the search field (role="combobox") which controls a role="listbox" of role="option" commands in role="group"s named by their headings. Typing filters by label, keywords and group and highlights the first match; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight (aria-activedescendant) while focus stays in the field; Enter runs the highlighted command; Escape closes and focus returns to where it was. The hotkeys toggle the palette from anywhere; every command shows its own shortcut, so the palette also teaches them. Disabled commands are shown, so the user learns they exist, but cannot run. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns Dialog's transitions off. The palette takes the theme and density of the region where it is placed.

### ContextMenu

[context-menu.json](context-menu.json): A menu opened by a right-click or the context-menu key on an area, on Base UI's ContextMenu: DropdownMenu's items (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus) at the pointer, on color.bg.overlay at z.popover.

Usage: Use ContextMenu for the actions of the thing under the pointer: a tree node, a grid cell, a tab. Compose it as ContextMenu > ContextMenuTrigger (the area; give it its own classes) + ContextMenuContent > ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup with ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuGroup with ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, and ContextMenuSub > ContextMenuSubTrigger + ContextMenuSubContent. A right-click is not discoverable and not available to everyone: every action in it must also be reachable another way (a toolbar, a DropdownMenu, the CommandPalette, a shortcut). For a menu behind a visible button use DropdownMenu.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/context-menu
- Parts: ContextMenuTrigger (data-slot context-menu-trigger): The area that opens the menu on right-click or the context-menu key; a <div>, unstyled.; ContextMenuContent (data-slot context-menu-content): The portal, the positioner at the pointer and the menu.; ContextMenuItem (data-slot context-menu-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; ContextMenuCheckboxItem (data-slot context-menu-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; ContextMenuRadioGroup (data-slot context-menu-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; ContextMenuRadioItem (data-slot context-menu-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; ContextMenuGroup (data-slot context-menu-group): role="group", named by its ContextMenuLabel.; ContextMenuLabel (data-slot context-menu-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ContextMenuSeparator (data-slot context-menu-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; ContextMenuShortcut (data-slot context-menu-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ContextMenuSubTrigger (data-slot context-menu-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; ContextMenuSubContent (data-slot context-menu-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean, default true); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, radius.md, radius.sm, size.control.lg, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.inline.lg, space.inline.sm, space.inset.md, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" and "menuitemradio" items with aria-checked; groups are role="group" named by their label. A right-click opens the menu at the pointer; on a focused area the context-menu key or Shift+F10 opens it (the browser sends the same contextmenu event). Focus moves into the menu; arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and returns focus. ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. Every action in a context menu is also available elsewhere (toolbar, DropdownMenu, CommandPalette, shortcut), because right-click is not discoverable. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off. The menu takes the area's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

### DatePicker

[date-picker.json](date-picker.json): A date or a range of dates, typed into a text field (read with date-fns in a format, yyyy-MM-dd by default) or picked from a Calendar in a popup, on InputGroup and Base UI's Popover, in three sizes.

Usage: Use DatePicker for a day in a form or a filter (a restore point, a snapshot date), and mode="range" for a window of days (query history, an audit period). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel: the text field takes the label, description and validity. The value is a local Date at midnight (range: { from, to }, both ends), or null when empty or when the text is not a date in format; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field, and validate null as missing. Limit the days with min, max and disabledDays (react-day-picker matchers, such as { dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }). Pass a date-fns locale for the calendar's language and first weekday; keep format unambiguous (yyyy-MM-dd, or dd/MM/yyyy where the locale reads it). For a time of day use TimePicker beside it; for a calendar that stays visible, Calendar.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/popover
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: mode ("single" | "range", default "single"); value (Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null); defaultValue (Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null); onValueChange ((value) => void); format (string, default "yyyy-MM-dd"); locale (Locale (date-fns)); min (Date); max (Date); disabledDays (Matcher | Matcher[]); weekStartsOn (0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6); numberOfMonths (number, default "1 (2 for a range)"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); placeholder (string); calendarLabel (string, default "Choose date"); open (boolean); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][aria-invalid=true]]), selected (data-selected), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xl, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The text field is named by its FieldLabel (or aria-label), described by FieldDescription and FieldError, and aria-invalid while its text is not a date; the placeholder shows the format to type. The calendar button is named by calendarLabel ("Choose date") and has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; Alt+ArrowDown in the text field opens the calendar too. When the popup opens, focus moves to the chosen day (else today); the arrow keys, PageUp and PageDown move it, Enter or Space picks it, and the popup closes and returns focus to the text field. Escape closes it without a change. The calendar is a role="grid" per month with full-date labels on the days; days outside min, max or disabledDays are disabled and struck through. Everything the popup does can be done by typing the date, so the field also works without a pointer or the popup.

### Dialog

[dialog.json](dialog.json): A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.

Usage: Use Dialog for a short task the user must finish or cancel before going on, on top of the page: export settings, rename, keyboard shortcuts, About. Compose it as Dialog > DialogTrigger (render a Button) + DialogContent > DialogHeader (DialogTitle, DialogDescription), DialogBody, DialogFooter (DialogClose rendering a Button, then the primary action last). Every dialog needs a DialogTitle; open it without a trigger through open and onOpenChange (from a menu item or a shortcut). For a decision that must not be dismissed by a click outside (delete, destructive SQL, approve access) use AlertDialog; for a form that edits something beside the page (a connection) use Sheet; for a small, non-modal panel attached to a control use Popover.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/dialog
- Parts: DialogTrigger (data-slot dialog-trigger): Opens the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render. aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.; DialogContent (data-slot dialog-content): The portal with the scrim, the viewport and the popup, plus a close IconButton unless showClose is false.; DialogBackdrop (data-slot dialog-backdrop): The scrim; DialogContent renders it.; DialogViewport (data-slot dialog-viewport): The centring layer; DialogContent renders it.; DialogHeader (data-slot dialog-header): The title and description, stacked, leaving room for the close button.; DialogTitle (data-slot dialog-title): An <h2> in type.heading-4 that names the dialog (aria-labelledby).; DialogDescription (data-slot dialog-description): A <p> in color.fg.muted that describes the dialog (aria-describedby).; DialogBody (data-slot dialog-body): The content between header and footer; scrolls when the dialog is taller than the viewport.; DialogFooter (data-slot dialog-footer): The actions at the end of the row, the primary action last.; DialogClose (data-slot dialog-close): Closes the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render.
- size: sm, md, lg, xl
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", default "md"); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean | "trap-focus", default true); disablePointerDismissal (boolean, default false); showClose (boolean, default true); closeLabel (string, default "Close"); initialFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); finalFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, elevation.modal.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.slow, motion.easing.emphasized, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.icon.sm, size.panel.lg, size.panel.md, size.panel.sm, size.panel.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.stack.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.heading-4.leading, text.heading-4.size, text.heading-4.tracking, text.heading-4.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The popup is role="dialog", named by DialogTitle (aria-labelledby) and described by DialogDescription (aria-describedby); every dialog has a title. While it is open the rest of the page is hidden from assistive technology and inert (Base UI marks it, rather than setting aria-modal). Opening moves focus into the popup (the first focusable element, or initialFocus); Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside; closing returns focus to the trigger (or finalFocus). Escape closes the dialog, and so does a press on the scrim unless disablePointerDismissal is set; the page behind does not scroll and ignores the pointer while it is open. The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name (closeLabel, "Close" by default) and a visible focus ring. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off (motion-reduce:transition-none). The popup takes the theme and density of the region it is declared in, not only of <html>, so its contrast matches the page that opened it.

### DropdownMenu

[dropdown-menu.json](dropdown-menu.json): A menu of actions opened from a button, on Base UI's Menu: items with shortcuts and a danger tone, checkbox and radio items, groups with labels, separators and submenus, on color.bg.overlay at z.popover.

Usage: Use DropdownMenu for a list of actions or options behind one button: tab actions under a "more" IconButton, copy formats, view options. Compose it as DropdownMenu > DropdownMenuTrigger (render a Button or IconButton) + DropdownMenuContent > DropdownMenuItem (onClick; danger for a destructive one; DropdownMenuShortcut at the end), DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (checked, onCheckedChange), DropdownMenuRadioGroup (value, onValueChange) with DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuGroup with DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, and DropdownMenuSub > DropdownMenuSubTrigger + DropdownMenuSubContent for a submenu. For a menu on right-click use ContextMenu; for an app's menu row, Menubar; for a primary action with variants, SplitButton; for picking a form value, Select; for a searchable list of every command, CommandPalette.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/menu
- Parts: DropdownMenuTrigger (data-slot dropdown-menu-trigger): Opens the menu; unstyled, render a Button or IconButton. aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.; DropdownMenuContent (data-slot dropdown-menu-content): The portal, the positioner and the menu.; DropdownMenuItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; DropdownMenuRadioGroup (data-slot dropdown-menu-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; DropdownMenuRadioItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; DropdownMenuGroup (data-slot dropdown-menu-group): role="group", named by its DropdownMenuLabel.; DropdownMenuLabel (data-slot dropdown-menu-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; DropdownMenuSeparator (data-slot dropdown-menu-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; DropdownMenuShortcut (data-slot dropdown-menu-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; DropdownMenuSubTrigger (data-slot dropdown-menu-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; DropdownMenuSubContent (data-slot dropdown-menu-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean, default true); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "bottom"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "start"); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.inline.lg, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; the popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" (aria-checked) and "menuitemradio" items; groups are role="group" named by their label. Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens the menu with the first item highlighted (ArrowUp: the last); arrow keys, Home and End move, typing jumps to an item, Enter or Space chooses, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. ArrowRight (inline-end) on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable by the keyboard, as the ARIA menu pattern recommends, but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. A press outside closes the menu. A destructive item has danger and a clear label, so the meaning does not rest on colour; checked state shows a check mark or dot as well as aria-checked. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off. The menu and its submenus take the trigger's theme and density, and sit at z.popover so a menu opened from a dialog is above it.

### Field

[field.json](field.json): A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.

Usage: Wrap every form control (Input, Textarea, InputGroup) in a Field with a FieldLabel; add FieldDescription for a hint and FieldError for the message. A Checkbox or Switch goes inside its FieldLabel, next to the text. A group of options (RadioGroup, CheckboxGroup) is one Field: a FieldLegend first inside the group, then a FieldItem per option with its FieldLabel and, if needed, its own FieldDescription. Group related Fields under a heading with FieldSet and FieldLegend. With TanStack Form, render it from form.Field and pass the field: <form.Field name="host">{(field) => <Field field={field}>…</Field>}</form.Field>, and wire the control's value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Without a form library, set invalid and FieldError's children yourself, or use Base UI's validate prop. Put the fields in a Form.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/field
- Parts: FieldLabel (data-slot field-label): The visible label, tied to the control; an inline row with gap space.inline.sm, so it can wrap a Checkbox, Radio or Switch and its text; danger-coloured while invalid, dimmed while disabled.; FieldDescription (data-slot field-description): A hint under the control, in color.fg.muted, named by aria-describedby.; FieldError (data-slot field-error): The validation message in color.status.danger.fg: its children, its errors prop, or the TanStack field's errors one per line.; FieldItem (data-slot field-item): One option of a RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup: its FieldLabel and FieldDescription in a column with gap space.stack.xs; disabled disables that option.; FieldSet (data-slot field-set): A <fieldset> grouping related Fields under a FieldLegend, a column with gap space.stack.md; disabled disables every control inside.; FieldLegend (data-slot field-legend): The name of a FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup, placed first inside it, in text.label; the group's aria-labelledby points to it.
- Props: field (FieldState (a TanStack Form field: name and state.meta)); name (string); invalid (boolean); touched (boolean); dirty (boolean); disabled (boolean, default false); validate ((value, formValues) => string | string[] | null | Promise<…>); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.status.danger.fg, font.sans, opacity.disabled, space.inline.sm, space.stack.md, space.stack.xs, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: FieldLabel is a <label> tied to the control, so clicking it focuses the control and screen readers announce it as the control's name. FieldDescription and FieldError are named in the control's aria-describedby; the error is read when the control is focused. A FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup is named by its FieldLegend through aria-labelledby; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only. An invalid field sets aria-invalid on the control; the message, not the danger colour, carries the meaning. Show errors after the user leaves the field or submits (the default with a TanStack field: touched and invalid), not on the first keystroke. color.status.danger.fg and color.fg.muted are contrast-checked as text on every surface.

### FileInput

[file-input.json](file-input.json): A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.

Usage: Use FileInput to pick local files the app reads in the browser or sends with the form: a CA certificate, a key, SQL scripts to import. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set accept (".pem,.crt", "image/*") and multiple as on the native input. Read the files from onFilesChange ([] when cleared); with TanStack Form, keep File[] in the field and call field.handleChange from onFilesChange. The dropzone variant also takes dropped files (filtered by accept) and suits imports; the field variant suits settings forms. Nothing is uploaded by the component; it has no network code.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- variant: field, dropzone
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: onFilesChange ((files: File[]) => void); accept (string); multiple (boolean, default false); variant ("field" | "dropzone", default "field"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); chooseLabel (string, default "Choose file"); emptyLabel (string, default "No file chosen"); dropLabel (string, default "Drop a file here, or"); clearLabel (string, default "Clear file"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input]:focus-visible]), dragging (data-dragging), empty (data-empty), invalid (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.subtle-bg, color.neutral.subtle-fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input type="file">, visually hidden but focusable: Tab reaches it, Space or Enter opens the system picker, and screen readers announce its label and the chosen file. The chip and the file names repeat what the input announces, so they are aria-hidden; the FieldLabel names the input and clicking it opens the picker. Dropping files is a pointer shortcut only; the same files can always be chosen with the keyboard. Announce what was added in a role="status" element. The Clear button is named "Clear file" and returns focus to the input. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame (3:1 on every surface).

### Form

[form.json](form.json): A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.

Usage: Create the form with useForm from @tanstack/react-form (defaultValues, validators, onSubmit), pass it as form, and render each field with form.Field and a Field inside. For a native-like flow use validationLogic: revalidateLogic({ mode: "submit", modeAfterSubmission: "change" }); for per-field checks use validators.onBlur. Show the submit state with form.Subscribe and Button's loading. Without form, Form is only a styled <form>.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Props: form (AnyFormApi (from useForm)); noValidate (boolean); onSubmit ((event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void); aria-label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLFormElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: space.stack.md
- Accessibility: Renders a native <form>, so Enter in a text field submits it; keep a type="submit" Button in it. After a failed submit, focus moves to the first invalid control in document order, and its FieldError is read through aria-describedby. Name the form with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one. Errors appear on submit and then follow each change (revalidateLogic) or on blur, never on the first keystroke of an untouched field. Announce the outcome of a submission in a role="status" region; the submit Button's loading sets aria-busy.

### HoverCard

[hover-card.json](hover-card.json): A preview of what a link points to, on Base UI's PreviewCard: shown while the pointer rests on the link or the link has keyboard focus, styled as a Popover, size.panel.sm wide.

Usage: Use HoverCard to preview the target of a link without leaving the page: a table name in a message, a foreign key, a connection in the status bar. Compose it as HoverCard > HoverCardTrigger (the link: href and the page's link classes) + HoverCardContent (side, align) with read-only content. The link must work without the card and the card must not hold anything the user needs to click: it disappears when the pointer leaves. For a label on an icon button use Tooltip; for controls the user clicks to open, Popover.

- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.link, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.ring, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, radius.md, radius.xs, ring.offset, ring.width, size.panel.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inset.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger is an ordinary link, named by its text; it works (Enter follows it) whether or not the card opens. The card opens on hover after delay and on keyboard focus of the link; Escape closes it and focus stays on the link; leaving the link and the card closes it after closeDelay. The card is supplementary and read-only: nothing in it is required to complete a task, so screen-reader users lose nothing when it is not announced. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off. The card takes the link's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

### IconButton

[icon-button.json](icon-button.json): A square, icon-only action button with Button's four variants in three density-aware sizes, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

Usage: Use IconButton where a familiar icon says enough and space is tight: toolbars, table rows, inside an InputGroup. Put an <svg aria-hidden> inside and describe the action in aria-label ("Copy connection string", not "Copy icon"); the type requires it. Ghost is the default; use primary for the one main action of a toolbar. When the icon is not obvious, use a Button with text instead.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/button
- variant: primary, secondary, ghost, danger
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: aria-label (string); variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", default "ghost"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); loading (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); type ("button" | "submit" | "reset", default "button"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.fg.default, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, space.inline.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it. aria-label is required by the type and names the action; mark the icon aria-hidden so it is not read twice. Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy. The smallest size (size.control.sm, 22 px in compact) passes WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum 24 px) only with spacing around it; keep IconButtons at least gap-inline-xs apart, or use md in dense toolbars. The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only and meets 3:1 against every surface; every variant's colours are contrast-checked by the token build.

### Input

[input.json](input.json): A single-line text input in three density-aware sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

Usage: Put Input inside a Field with a FieldLabel (and FieldDescription and FieldError as needed); it takes the label, description and validity from it. Use Textarea for multi-line text and InputGroup for an icon, a unit or a button attached to the input. Match the size to the controls beside it.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-invalid (boolean | "true" | "false"); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (aria-invalid), invalid-in-field (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)

- Accessibility: Renders a native <input>; give it a visible <label> (or a Base UI Field.Label), or aria-label when there is no room for one. Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface. ### InputGroup

[input-group.json](input-group.json): A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

Usage: Use InputGroup when something belongs to the input: a search icon, a fixed prefix (postgres://), a unit (ms), or an action on the value (Copy, Test, Show). Put InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton before or after InputGroupInput in the order they should appear, and wrap the group in a Field for its label and error. For an unrelated action next to an input, use a plain Input and a Button side by side.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- Parts: InputGroupInput (data-slot input-group-input): The text control (Base UI's Input): takes a Field's label and validity; its value, onValueChange and onBlur as Input's.; InputGroupAddon (data-slot input-group-addon): An icon or text in color.fg.muted; clicking it focuses the control.; InputGroupButton (data-slot input-group-button): A Button (ghost by default) one size smaller than the group, inset from the frame; Button's props.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)

- Accessibility: The control is a native <input>; give it a FieldLabel through a Field, or aria-label. Addon text is not part of its name: say in the label or description what a prefix means. Mark decorative addon icons aria-hidden; an icon-only InputGroupButton needs aria-label. Tab moves from the control to the button; the frame's ring follows the control, the button has its own focus ring. Clicking an addon focuses the control, so the whole frame is a click target. The frame border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface; invalid uses color.status.danger.border and FieldError's message, not colour alone.

### Kbd

[kbd.json](kbd.json): A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

Usage: Use Kbd in help text, menus and tooltips to show a key (Esc) or, with KbdGroup, a shortcut (Ctrl + K). Write the separator between the keys as text (+, then). Kbd shows a shortcut; it does not bind one. For a symbol (⌘, ⇧) add hidden text that names the key.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: KbdGroup (data-slot kbd-group): Lines up the keys of one shortcut with their text separators, in text.caption and color.fg.muted.
- Props: children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.border.default, color.fg.muted, font.mono, font.sans, radius.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight
- Accessibility: Renders <kbd>, which marks keyboard input; KbdGroup is an outer <kbd>, as HTML nests the keys of a combination. Screen readers read the key labels and the text separators; write "Ctrl", not an icon alone. A <kbd> takes no aria-label: give a symbol (⌘) visually hidden text (sr-only) and mark the symbol aria-hidden. Not focusable and not interactive; nothing to operate. color.fg.muted on color.bg.inset is contrast-checked as text by the token build.

### Menubar

[menubar.json](menubar.json): A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop window, on Base UI's Menubar: titles that open DropdownMenu-style menus (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus), moving between menus with the arrow keys or the pointer once one is open.

Usage: Use Menubar for an application's menu row in a web build, where the window has no native menu: File, Query, View, Help. Compose it as Menubar > MenubarMenu (one per menu) > MenubarTrigger (the title) + MenubarContent > MenubarItem (MenubarShortcut at the end; danger for a destructive one), MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarRadioGroup with MenubarRadioItem, MenubarGroup with MenubarLabel, MenubarSeparator, MenubarSub > MenubarSubTrigger + MenubarSubContent. Keep the commands also in the CommandPalette. On the desktop prefer the native menu; for one menu behind a button use DropdownMenu; for site navigation (links) use NavigationMenu.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/menubar
- Parts: MenubarTrigger (data-slot menubar-trigger): A menu's title in the row (role="menuitem", aria-haspopup="menu"), in type.label; color.interactive.hover while hovered or open.; MenubarContent (data-slot menubar-content): The portal, the positioner under the title and the menu.; MenubarItem (data-slot menubar-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; MenubarCheckboxItem (data-slot menubar-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; MenubarRadioGroup (data-slot menubar-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; MenubarRadioItem (data-slot menubar-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; MenubarGroup (data-slot menubar-group): role="group", named by its MenubarLabel.; MenubarLabel (data-slot menubar-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; MenubarSeparator (data-slot menubar-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; MenubarShortcut (data-slot menubar-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; MenubarSubTrigger (data-slot menubar-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; MenubarSubContent (data-slot menubar-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); loopFocus (boolean, default true); modal (boolean, default true); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.inline.lg, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The row is role="menubar"; each title is role="menuitem" with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; each popup is role="menu" of menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items. One title is in the tab order; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between titles (wrapping), Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a menu with its first item highlighted; while a menu is open ArrowLeft and ArrowRight open the neighbouring menu; Escape closes and returns focus to the title. Inside a menu: arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses; ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. Once one menu is open, moving the pointer over another title opens that menu. Titles have a visible focus ring; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the menus' scale and fade off. Every command is also in the CommandPalette with its shortcut.

### MultiSelect

[multi-select.json](multi-select.json): Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

Usage: Use MultiSelect when the user picks any number of values from a list (columns, privileges, schemas, tags). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items and a function child that renders each one as a ComboboxItem, as for Combobox; value is an array. Items that are { value, label } objects show their label on the chip; for ids from a Combobox.createItems collection pass itemToStringLabel. The list stays open after each choice; Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For one value use Combobox or Select; for a few always-visible options, a CheckboxGroup.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/combobox

- States: focus-visible (has-[input:focus-visible]), has values (has-[[data-slot=multi-select-chip]]), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), hover (hover), chip highlighted (data-highlighted), no value (not-data-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.focus, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.neutral.subtle-bg, color.neutral.subtle-fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, space.control.x, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable, and chosen items have aria-selected and a check mark. Typing filters; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter adds or removes the highlighted item and the list stays open. Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip; ArrowLeft at the start of the input moves onto the chips, where Backspace or Delete removes one. Each chip is named by its text and its remove button by removeLabel ("Remove SELECT"); the clear button is named by clearLabel. The chevron is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology. Chips use color.neutral.subtle with color.neutral.subtle-fg (4.5:1), and the highlighted chip color.interactive.selected, with a focus ring as well. The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

### NumberInput

[number-input.json](number-input.json): A number input on Base UI's NumberField with decrement and increment buttons, bounds, steps, locale formatting, and three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use NumberInput for a number the user types or nudges: a port, a pool size, a timeout. - Accessibility: The text control is an <input> with inputmode="decimal" (Base UI); inside a Field it takes the label, description and aria-invalid. Without a Field, give it an aria-label. Arrow Up and Down change the value by step, Shift+arrow and PageUp/PageDown by largeStep, Home and End jump to min and max. The step buttons are named Decrease and Increase and stay out of the tab order (the keyboard already steps); they disable at the limits. A formatted value ("30 seconds") is read as shown; the form submits the plain number. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Popover

[popover.json](popover.json): A small non-modal panel attached to a control, on Base UI's Popover: a trigger, and a popup on color.bg.overlay with an optional title, description, controls and a close action, placed on any side of the trigger.

Usage: Use Popover for a few controls or a short explanation that belongs to one control and should not block the page: run options under an icon button, the details of a status badge, a colour picker. Compose it as Popover > PopoverTrigger (render a Button or an IconButton) + PopoverContent (side, align) > PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription, Fields, PopoverClose rendering a Button. It is not modal: the user can click elsewhere and it closes. For text that only names or explains a control on hover, use Tooltip; for a preview of a link on hover, HoverCard; for a list of actions, DropdownMenu; for a task that must be finished or cancelled, Dialog.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/popover
- Parts: PopoverTrigger (data-slot popover-trigger): Opens and closes the popover; unstyled, render a Button or IconButton through render. aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.; PopoverContent (data-slot popover-content): The portal, the positioner and the popup.; PopoverTitle (data-slot popover-title): An <h2> in type.body-strong that names the popup.; PopoverDescription (data-slot popover-description): A <p> in color.fg.muted that describes the popup.; PopoverClose (data-slot popover-close): Closes the popover; unstyled, render a Button through render.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean | "trap-focus", default false); openOnHover (boolean, default false); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "bottom"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "center"); sideOffset (number); initialFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.overlay, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, size.panel.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inset.md, space.inset.sm, space.stack.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; the popup is role="dialog", named by PopoverTitle and described by PopoverDescription when they are there. Enter or Space on the trigger opens it and moves focus into the popup; Tab moves through its controls and out of it, which closes it; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. A press outside closes it; it is not modal, so the page stays usable and is not hidden from assistive technology. An icon trigger is an IconButton with an aria-label. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off. The popup takes the trigger's theme and density even in a scoped region, and sits at z.popover, so a popover opened from a dialog is above it.

### RadioGroup

[radio-group.json](radio-group.json): One choice out of several, on Base UI's RadioGroup and Radio: a fieldset of radios named by a FieldLegend, each option in a FieldItem with its own label and description, in three sizes.

Usage: Use RadioGroup when the user must pick exactly one of two to about six options and should see them all at once (TLS mode, line endings). - States: hover (hover), checked (data-checked), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)

- Accessibility: Renders a <div role="radiogroup"> named by its FieldLegend (aria-labelledby), with a <span role="radio"> and aria-checked per option, and hidden native inputs for forms. Tab enters the group at the chosen radio (or the first) and leaves it; arrow keys move the choice, skipping disabled radios. Wrap each radio and its text in a FieldLabel: the text chooses it too, which enlarges the target beyond the 14 to 20 px circle (WCAG 2.2 target size). A FieldDescription inside the FieldItem describes that option only. The chosen radio shows a dot as well as the accent fill; the border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface).
