- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), placeholder (data-placeholder), highlighted (data-highlighted), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.focus, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger is a <button role="combobox"> with aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected. Enter, Space, ArrowDown and ArrowUp open the popup; arrow keys, Home and End move the highlight, typing jumps to the option that starts with the text, Enter chooses and Escape closes, and focus returns to the trigger. Disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and shown in color.fg.disabled; a group's label names the group (aria-labelledby). The chosen option shows a check mark as well as its place in the trigger, so the state does not rest on colour; the trigger border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). The popup takes the trigger's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>, so its contrast matches the page it opened from.

### Sheet

[sheet.json](sheet.json): A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the window over a scrim, on Base UI's Dialog: right, left, top or bottom, three widths, a header, a scrolling body, a pinned footer and a close button.

Usage: Use Sheet for a form or a detail view that belongs beside the page rather than in front of it: edit a connection, a cell's full value, filters. Compose it as Sheet > SheetTrigger (render a Button; or open it through open) + SheetContent > SheetHeader (SheetTitle, SheetDescription), SheetBody (the Fields; it scrolls), SheetFooter (SheetClose rendering a Button, then the primary action). side picks the edge (right by default) and size the width of a left or right sheet; a top or bottom sheet spans the window and is as tall as its content. Every sheet needs a SheetTitle. For a short task in the middle of the screen use Dialog; for a decision use AlertDialog; for a sidebar that stays open next to the content use Sidebar.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/dialog
- Parts: SheetTrigger (data-slot sheet-trigger): Opens the sheet; unstyled, render a Button through render.; SheetContent (data-slot sheet-content): The portal with the scrim and the sheet, plus a close IconButton unless showClose is false.; SheetBackdrop (data-slot sheet-backdrop): The scrim; SheetContent renders it.; SheetHeader (data-slot sheet-header): The title and description, stacked, leaving room for the close button.; SheetTitle (data-slot sheet-title): An <h2> in type.heading-4 that names the sheet.; SheetDescription (data-slot sheet-description): A <p> in color.fg.muted that describes the sheet.; SheetBody (data-slot sheet-body): The content; takes the free height and scrolls.; SheetFooter (data-slot sheet-footer): The actions, pinned at the bottom of the sheet.; SheetClose (data-slot sheet-close): Closes the sheet; unstyled, render a Button through render.
- side: right, left, top, bottom
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: side ("right" | "left" | "top" | "bottom", default "right"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); disablePointerDismissal (boolean, default false); showClose (boolean, default true); closeLabel (string, default "Close"); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, elevation.modal.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.slow, motion.easing.emphasized, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.icon.sm, size.panel.lg, size.panel.md, size.panel.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.stack.md, space.stack.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight, text.heading-4.leading, text.heading-4.size, text.heading-4.tracking, text.heading-4.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The sheet is role="dialog", named by SheetTitle and described by SheetDescription; while it is open the page behind is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Opening moves focus into the sheet; Tab stays inside; Escape or a press on the scrim closes it and focus returns to the trigger. The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name and a visible focus ring. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide off (motion-reduce:transition-none); the sheet appears in place. The sheet takes the theme and density of the region it is declared in.

### Slider

[slider.json](slider.json): A slider on Base UI's Slider: one value or a range with two thumbs, horizontal or vertical, on a size.track track with an accent indicator, in three thumb sizes.

Usage: Use Slider for a value in a known range where the position matters more than the exact number (a sample percentage, a zoom level), or for a range with two thumbs. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel, and show the current value in the label or next to it; name each thumb of a range with getAriaLabel. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur (onValueCommitted for work that should run only when the user lets go). For an exact number, use NumberInput, or pair the two.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/slider
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (number | number[]); defaultValue (number | number[]); onValueChange ((value: number | number[], details) => void); onValueCommitted ((value: number | number[], details) => void); min (number, default 0); max (number, default 100); step (number, default 1); largeStep (number, default 10); minStepsBetweenValues (number, default 0); orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); aria-label (string); getAriaLabel ((index: number) => string); format (Intl.NumberFormatOptions); name (string); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), dragging (data-dragging), focus-visible (has-[:focus-visible]), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, ring.offset, ring.width, shadow.raised, size.control.xs, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.track
- Accessibility: Each thumb holds a native <input type="range">, so screen readers announce it as a slider with its value, and Tab reaches each thumb. Arrow keys move by step, PageUp/PageDown and Shift+arrow by largeStep, Home and End to min and max. A FieldLabel names a single thumb; name both thumbs of a range with getAriaLabel ("Minimum length", "Maximum length"). Use format so units are announced. The thumb has a color.border.strong border (3:1 against the surface and the track); the selected part is the accent solid. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the thumb (3:1 on every surface).

### SplitButton

[split-button.json](split-button.json): A primary action joined to a menu of its variants: a Button and a chevron IconButton that opens a DropdownMenu (Base UI's Menu), in three variants and three sizes.

Usage: Use SplitButton when one action is the usual choice and a few close variants should stay one click away: Run (statement under cursor) with Run selection and Explain in the menu, Export CSV with other formats. Put the action's label in children and its handler in onClick, and the menu's DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuLabel and DropdownMenuSeparator in menu; name the menu button with menuLabel. loading shows the action running while the menu stays usable. When there is no usual choice, use a DropdownMenu behind a plain Button; for unrelated actions, separate Buttons.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- variant: primary, secondary, ghost
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: children (ReactNode); onClick (MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>); menu (ReactNode); menuLabel (string, default "More options"); variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost", default "primary"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); disabled (boolean, default false); loading (boolean, default false); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "end"); open (boolean); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-popup-open), loading (data-loading), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.overlay, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The control is a role="group" of two buttons, each in the tab order: the action, named by its label, and the menu button, named by menuLabel, with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded. Enter or Space on the action runs it; on the menu button, Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu with the first item highlighted; Escape closes it and returns focus to the menu button. The menu follows DropdownMenu: arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses; a press outside closes it. loading keeps the action focusable and sets aria-busy; the divider is a border colour, and the halves are separate buttons, so the split does not rest on colour alone. The menu takes the control's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

### Switch

[switch.json](switch.json): An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the accent solid and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.

Usage: Use Switch for a setting that takes effect as soon as it is flipped ("Auto-commit", "Read-only connection"), in settings panels and side panels. Wrap it in a FieldLabel with its text (the text may come first) inside a Field, and add a FieldDescription for what it does; group related switches in a FieldSet with a FieldLegend. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur to the field. For a choice that only applies when a form is submitted, use Checkbox; for a toolbar toggle, ToggleButton.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/switch
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: checked (boolean); defaultChecked (boolean, default false); onCheckedChange ((checked: boolean, details) => void); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); name (string); value (string); uncheckedValue (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLSpanElement>)
- States: hover (hover), checked (data-checked), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, ring.offset, ring.width, shadow.raised, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs
- Accessibility: Renders a <span role="switch"> with aria-checked and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it, Space and Enter flip it. Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text flips it too and enlarges the target beyond the track (WCAG 2.2 target size). Name the setting, not the state ("Auto-commit", not "Auto-commit on"). On and off differ by the thumb's position as well as the track colour; the off track is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). The thumb slides in the reading direction (right in LTR, left in RTL). Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Tabs

[tabs.json](tabs.json): Tabs on Base UI's Tabs: a strip of tabs (underline or enclosed, two sizes, horizontal or vertical) with panels; tabs can carry a status icon, be closed with a button or Delete, and be reordered by drag or Alt+Shift+Arrow.

Usage: Use Tabs to switch between views of the same place: the sections of a Settings dialog (variant line), or DBee's query tabs (variant enclosed, size sm). Compose it as Tabs (value, onValueChange) > TabsList > TabsTrigger per tab (value, icon for a status, children for the title) + TabsContent per tab. For closable tabs pass onClose on each TabsTrigger and keep the tabs in state (Tabs controlled): when the active tab closes, choose the next one. For reorderable tabs pass onReorder(value, index) on TabsList and move the tab in your array. For navigation between pages use NavigationMenu or Sidebar; for a choice that filters content in place, ToggleGroup.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/tabs
- Parts: TabsList (data-slot tabs-list): role="tablist"; scrolls when the tabs do not fit; onReorder makes the tabs movable.; TabsTrigger (data-slot tabs-trigger): role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls: icon, truncated title, and a close button when closable.; TabsContent (data-slot tabs-content): role="tabpanel", labelled by its tab.
- variant: line, enclosed
- size: sm, md
- Props: value (string | number); onValueChange ((value, details) => void); variant ("line" | "enclosed", default "line"); size ("sm" | "md", default "md"); orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); onReorder ((value, index: number) => void); activateOnFocus (boolean, default false); icon (ReactNode); onClose (() => void); closeLabel (string, default "Close tab"); disabled (boolean, default false); keepMounted (boolean, default false); className (string)
- States: active (data-active), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), closable (data-closable), dragging (data-dragging), drop-target (data-[drop=before])
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, size.panel.xs, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.sticky
- Accessibility: The strip is role="tablist" of role="tab" elements with aria-selected and aria-controls; each panel is role="tabpanel" labelled by its tab. Only the active tab is in the tab order. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (ArrowUp and ArrowDown when vertical), Home and End move between tabs; Enter or Space activates the focused tab (or focus activates it with activateOnFocus). A closable tab closes with Delete when focused (aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"); its close button is for the pointer, out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology so the tablist holds only tabs. Focus moves to the neighbouring tab. A reorderable tab moves with Alt+Shift+ArrowLeft and Alt+Shift+ArrowRight (Up and Down when vertical), announced through aria-keyshortcuts, as well as by drag, so reordering does not need a pointer. A status icon needs a text alternative (role="img" with aria-label, or visually hidden text), since a coloured dot alone carries no meaning. Only colours transition; nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.

### Textarea

[textarea.json](textarea.json): A multi-line text input on Base UI's Input rendering a <textarea>, in Input's three sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Field.

Usage: Use Textarea for text that may span lines (descriptions, notes, filters, short SQL); use Input for one line and the SQL editor for real queries. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set rows to the expected length (3 by default). It resizes vertically; pass className="resize-none" to stop that.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); rows (number, default 3); value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-invalid (boolean | "true" | "false"); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (aria-invalid), invalid-in-field (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.subtle, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <textarea>; give it a FieldLabel (or a <label>), or aria-label when there is no room for one. Enter inserts a line break and Tab leaves the field, as in any textarea; do not trap Tab. Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface. Mark errors with a Field (aria-invalid and aria-describedby follow) or aria-invalid; the danger border is not the only signal. The border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface; focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

### TimePicker

[time-picker.json](time-picker.json): A time of day typed into hour, minute, optional second and AM/PM segments, on Base UI's Input: the arrow keys step a segment and digits fill it, in three sizes.

Usage: Use TimePicker for a time of day (a backup schedule, a maintenance window). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel. The value is "HH:mm" ("HH:mm:ss" with seconds) on the 24-hour clock whatever hourCycle shows, and null until every segment is set; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. A native form submits the text shown: the value itself on the 24-hour clock, "02:05 PM" with hourCycle={12}. hourCycle={12} adds an AM/PM segment (A and P set it). For a date use DatePicker; for a duration or a number of seconds, NumberInput.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (string | null); defaultValue (string | null); onValueChange ((value: string | null) => void); seconds (boolean, default false); hourCycle (12 | 24, default 24); minuteStep (number, default 1); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); placeholder (string, default "--:--"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), placeholder (placeholder), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.selected, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, space.control.x, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight
- Accessibility: A text input named by its FieldLabel (or aria-label) and described by FieldDescription and FieldError; its value reads as a time ("14:05", "02:05 PM"). Focus selects the hour; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (or typing a colon) move between segments, ArrowUp and ArrowDown step the selected one and wrap, Home and End set its lowest and highest value, Backspace and Delete clear it. Tab leaves the field. Digits fill the selected segment and move on when it is complete ("9" in the hour gives 09); A and P set AM or PM. Pasting "14:05", "2:05 pm" or "14:05:30" sets every segment. It needs no pointer and no popup, and the shape of the time (the placeholder) shows which segments exist. Mark it invalid through its Field, which also links the error text; required and the pattern of the segments give Base UI's Field the native validity.

### Toast

[toast.json](toast.json): Notifications on Base UI's Toast: a region in a corner of the window (or in the page flow) of toasts with a title, a description, a tone (info, success, warning, danger), an optional action and a close button; sticky toasts and high-priority announcements; no network.

Usage: Use Toast for short news about something the user did or that happened in the background: an export finished, a connection dropped, access is about to expire. Put one Toast near the root of the app with the app inside it, then call useToast().add({ title, description, type, timeout, priority, actionProps: { children, onClick } }) from any component, or pass a manager from createToastManager() as toastManager to add toasts from outside React. timeout: 0 keeps a toast until dismissed (use it for anything with an action the user must not miss); priority: "high" announces it at once. Errors that block a task belong on the page (an Alert); a decision belongs in an AlertDialog.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/toast
- Parts: ToastItem (data-slot toast-item): One toast: role="dialog" ("alertdialog" for high priority), color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay and a coloured inner-edge border by tone; Toast renders one per toast.
- placement: bottom-end, top-end, bottom-center, static
- Props: placement ("bottom-end" | "top-end" | "bottom-center" | "static", default "bottom-end"); limit (number, default 3); timeout (number, default 5000); toastManager (ToastManager); closeLabel (string, default "Dismiss"); aria-label (string, default "Notifications"); children (ReactNode); className (string); add(options) ({ title, description, type, timeout, priority, actionProps, onClose } => id)
- States: tone (data-[type=danger]), entering (data-starting-style), leaving (data-ending-style), limited (data-limited), focus-visible (focus-visible)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, color.status.info.border, color.status.success.border, color.status.warning.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.panel.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, z.toast
- Accessibility: The region is role="region" named "Notifications" with aria-live="polite": new toasts are read without moving focus. A toast with priority "high" is also announced at once through a role="alert" copy. Each toast is a non-modal dialog labelled by its title and described by its description; its action is a Button and its close button an IconButton with an accessible name. F6 moves focus into the region (Base UI's hotkey) and Tab moves between toasts and their buttons; Escape closes the focused toast. Hovering or focusing the region pauses the timers. Anything the user must act on (an expiry warning with Renew) uses timeout 0 so it does not vanish before it can be reached. The tone is a border colour and the title says the same in words, so meaning does not rest on colour. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.

### ToggleButton

[toggle-button.json](toggle-button.json): A button that stays pressed or unpressed, on Base UI's Toggle, in a ghost or outline variant and three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use ToggleButton for a setting that is on or off and takes effect at once, in a toolbar or next to what it changes: word wrap in an editor, "show nulls" over a grid. Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"), not the action; the pressed state is announced. For one choice out of several, or several related toggles, use ToggleGroup; for a setting in a form, use Switch or Checkbox.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/toggle
- variant: ghost, outline
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: pressed (boolean); defaultPressed (boolean, default false); onPressedChange ((pressed: boolean, details) => void); variant ("ghost" | "outline", default "ghost"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), pressed (data-pressed), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with aria-pressed, so Enter and Space toggle it and screen readers announce "toggle button, pressed". Icon-only toggles need an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"); keep the name the same in both states, the pressed state carries the change. Pressed is shown by color.interactive.selected and a change from color.fg.muted to color.fg.default, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### ToggleGroup

[toggle-group.json](toggle-group.json): Toggle buttons with one shared value, on Base UI's ToggleGroup: a segmented outline track or quiet ghost items, single or multiple selection, horizontal or vertical, in three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use ToggleGroup for a small set of options that apply at once and stay visible: the result view (grid, JSON, chart), cell alignment, which columns to show. Name the group with aria-label and give each ToggleGroupItem a value; without multiple, one item is pressed at a time (the user can release it, so check for an empty value), with multiple any number. Wire value and onValueChange for controlled state. Outline is a segmented control; ghost suits toolbars. For a choice inside a form that must have exactly one answer, use RadioGroup; for one on/off setting, ToggleButton or Switch.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/toggle-group
- Parts: ToggleGroupItem (data-slot toggle-group-item): One toggle of the group, with ToggleButton's look; value identifies it, aria-label names an icon-only one.
- variant: outline, ghost
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (string[]); defaultValue (string[]); onValueChange ((value: string[], details) => void); multiple (boolean, default false); orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); variant ("outline" | "ghost", default "outline"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); disabled (boolean, default false); loopFocus (boolean, default true); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), pressed (data-pressed), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The group is a <div role="group">; name it with aria-label (or aria-labelledby). Each item is a native <button> with aria-pressed. Tab reaches the group once; arrow keys move between items (left and right, or up and down when vertical), Enter and Space press. Pressed is shown by color.interactive.selected and color.fg.default, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone. Icon-only items need an aria-label each. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Tooltip

[tooltip.json](tooltip.json): A short label for a control, shown on hover and keyboard focus, on Base UI's Tooltip: a neutral-solid bubble at z.tooltip on any side of the trigger, with an optional keyboard shortcut.

Usage: Use Tooltip to name an icon button or add a few words to a control, never for anything the user must read to act (put that on the page) and never on a disabled control (it cannot be focused). Compose it as Tooltip > TooltipTrigger (render the IconButton; it keeps its own aria-label) + TooltipContent (side, align) with the text and an optional TooltipShortcut. Wrap a toolbar in TooltipProvider (delay) so moving between its buttons shows each tooltip at once. Keep it to one line where possible. For a richer preview on hover use HoverCard; for controls or text the user clicks to open, Popover.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/tooltip
- Parts: TooltipTrigger (data-slot tooltip-trigger): The control; unstyled, render an IconButton or Button through render.; TooltipContent (data-slot tooltip-content): The portal, the positioner and the bubble.; TooltipShortcut (data-slot tooltip-shortcut): A <kbd> with the action's shortcut, in the code font, after the text.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); delay (number, default 600); closeDelay (number, default 0); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "top"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "center"); sideOffset (number); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), instant (data-instant)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.fg.default, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.base, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, size.panel.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.tooltip
- Accessibility: The tooltip is visual, as Base UI's: the trigger must have its own accessible name (an IconButton's aria-label says the same as the tooltip), so nothing depends on the tooltip being announced. It opens on hover after delay and at once on keyboard focus, and closes on Escape, when the pointer leaves or when focus moves away; the trigger keeps focus throughout. It holds no interactive content (a link or button inside cannot be reached); use Popover for that. The bubble pairs color.neutral.fg on color.neutral.bg, which the token build checks for contrast in every mode. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the fade off.

## Helpers

- [cn.json](cn.json): class-name merging that knows the role names; every component depends on it.
- [theme-scope.json](theme-scope.json): gives popups in a portal the theme and density of their trigger; the popup components depend on it.
